resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Arabic source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: An independent whole-locale pass identified 25 actionable Arabic translation defects in core electrical concept text; all 25 were corrected in this bounded iteration.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Arabic human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The current symbol I was mistranslated as the Arabic word for I rather than identified as current.
evidence: Before: أنا تيار، ويقاس بالأمبير أو الأمبير (A).
findings.resolution: Changed to: I هو التيار، ويقاس بالأمبير (A).

findings.summary: The worked-examples title was an unnatural literal translation.
findings.resolution: Changed to the natural Arabic title أمثلة محلولة.

findings.summary: The current example title used an unnatural literal phrase and the wrong noun form.
findings.resolution: Changed to: إيجاد التيار.

findings.summary: The current formula replaced the symbol I and units with Arabic words, obscuring the calculation.
findings.resolution: Changed to: I = 4.2 V / 1.0 Ω = 4.2 A.

findings.summary: The current conclusion omitted the copula and used a nonstandard unit abbreviation.
findings.resolution: Changed to: تيار الحمل هو 4.2 A.

findings.summary: The resistance example title used an inconsistent imperative phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed to the consistent title إيجاد المقاومة.

findings.summary: The resistance formula used the Arabic letter ص instead of the symbol R and mixed translated units.
findings.resolution: Changed to: R = 12 V / 2 A = 6 Ω.

findings.summary: The voltage example title used an inconsistent literal phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed to: إيجاد الجهد.

findings.summary: The voltage formula mixed Arabic unit names and abbreviations.
findings.resolution: Changed to: V = 0.5 A × 10 Ω = 5 V.

findings.summary: The electrical-power paragraph confused power with force and energy.
evidence: Before: علاقة القوة ... تكون الطاقة المثالية 17.64 واط.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph to consistently use القدرة and القدرة المثالية, with a natural translation of headroom.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating section title used a literal heating-power phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed to: قدرة التسخين.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating introduction repeated the unnatural title terminology.
findings.resolution: Changed to: قدرة التسخين الكهربائية هي:

findings.summary: The definition of P incorrectly called power energy.
findings.resolution: Changed to: P هي القدرة بالواط (W).

findings.summary: The definition of I used the Arabic word for current as an adjective rather than a clear noun phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed to: I هو التيار بالأمبير (A).

findings.summary: The worked-example title was an unnatural literal translation.
findings.resolution: Changed to the natural Arabic title مثال محلول.

findings.summary: The heating-effects title used an awkward preposition and literal wording.
findings.resolution: Changed to: ما يؤثر في التسخين.

findings.summary: The practical-checks title was a machine-translated false friend.
findings.resolution: Changed to: فحوصات عملية.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph used an incorrect literal translation for thermal headroom and awkward resistance wording.
evidence: Before: استخدم الإرتفاع المناسب ... يمكن أن تتغير المقاومة ...
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with اترك هامشًا مناسبًا and clear component-resistance wording.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms introduction contained an ungrammatical literal phrase.
evidence: Before: أسهل في التفكير فيما يلي:
findings.resolution: Changed to: تجعل المصطلحات الأساسية فهم مخطط الدائرة أسهل:

findings.summary: The current-law title used الحالي, which means current as an adjective rather than the electrical noun.
findings.resolution: Changed to the standard Arabic title قانون كيرشوف للتيار.

findings.summary: The current-law example used an unclear literal translation for current leaving a branch.
evidence: Before: حمل أحد الفروع 3 A بعيدًا ... اختر الاتجاهات الحالية قبل الحل.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the example as current leaving a branch and directions of current before calculation.

findings.summary: The series-resistor formula replaced the symbol I and units with Arabic words.
findings.resolution: Changed to: I = 8.0 V / 0.40 Ω = 20 A.

findings.summary: The parallel-branches formula retained English prose inside the Arabic locale.
findings.resolution: Changed to: (الفروع المتوازية).

findings.summary: The first circuit-solving bullet was ungrammatical and did not clearly instruct the reader to mark node voltages.
evidence: Before: علامة الفولتية العقدة، والتيارات الفرعية ...
findings.resolution: Changed to: حدّد جهود العقد وتيارات الفروع واتجاهات التيار المفترضة.

findings.summary: The simultaneous-equations instruction used an incorrect noun and an infinitive fragment.
evidence: Before: حل المعادلات الآنية والتحقق من توازن الطاقة.
findings.resolution: Changed to: حل المعادلات المتزامنة وتحقق من توازن الطاقة.
